chunks: Saʿdān narrated from him, عليه السلام, that he said:
There is no drop that descends from the sky except that with it is an angel who places it in the location that has been decreed for it.

key_terms.السَّمَاءِ: the sky, from which the rain descends
key_terms.الْمَوْضِعَ: the exact place or location where it is set down
key_terms.قَطْرَةٍ: a single drop, here referring to a drop of rain
key_terms.مَلَكٌ: an angel assigned to accompany and direct it

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe divine decree in the falling of rain?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the descent of rain as occurring under precise divine decree and angelic administration. It highlights that even a single drop falls only to its appointed place, reflecting Allah’s complete knowledge and ordering of creation.
